description: The road has narrow, continuous sidewalks on both sides: the left side is a paved strip with occasional grass/soil edging and a few driveway-like breaks, while the right side is a curb-and-stone edge with a narrower walkway and some uneven patches near the vegetation. Traffic is separated from pedestrians only by the curb/edge (no physical barrier), with a single lane in each direction and overhead utility lines; vehicles appear parked along the left side, reducing clearance. There is substantial greenery and tree cover providing shade, but lighting is not visible in this view, and there are obstacles such as trash bins on the right and parked cars on the left; no clearly marked curb ramps or accessible crossing features are visible.
